question: Who among the following received the 2025 Padma Bhushan for excellence in sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P. R. Sreejesh**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **P. R. Sreejesh**, an Indian field hockey player, was awarded the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** in **2025** for his exceptional contributions to the sport. 

• Sreejesh has been a standout performer as a **goalkeeper** for the Indian men’s hockey team and has played a pivotal role in numerous international tournaments. 

• He was instrumental in India winning the **bronze medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, ending a 41-year medal drought in hockey at the Olympics. 

• As a seasoned player, Sreejesh has captained the Indian team and contributed to victories in tournaments like the **Asian Champions Trophy** and the **Asia Cup**. 

• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished service of a high order in any field, including sports. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
 

• **P. R. Sreejesh:** 
 

• Sreejesh was born on **8 May 1988** in **Kizhakkambalam, Kerala**. 

• He joined the **Indian national hockey team** in **2006** and has since been one of its most consistent performers. 

• He has won several individual accolades, including the **World Games Athlete of the Year** in **2021** and the **FIH Goalkeeper of the Year** award multiple times. 

• He is known for his quick reflexes, sharp decision-making, and leadership abilities on the field. 
 
 

• **Padma Bhushan Award:** 
 

• The **Padma Bhushan** was instituted in **1954** and is one of the **highest civilian awards** in India. 

• It is awarded annually on **Republic Day** and is given for distinguished service of a high order in various fields, including **sports, arts, science, and public affairs**. 

• Sports personalities who have received this award in the past include **Mary Kom, Leander Paes**, and **P. V. Sindhu**. 
 
 

• **Notable Achievements of P. R. Sreejesh:** 
 

• He played a significant role in India’s victory at the **2014 Asian Games**, where they won the **gold medal**. 

• Sreejesh has represented India in multiple **World Cups** and **Champions Trophy** tournaments. 

• He has been honored with the **Arjuna Award** (2015) and the **Khel Ratna Award** (2021). 
 
 

• **Other Sports Personalities in the Options:** 
 

• **Dhanraj Pillay:** Former Indian hockey player and captain, known for his exceptional skills and contributions to Indian hockey, but he did not receive the Padma Bhushan in 2025. 

• **Mary Kom:** An Indian boxer and six-time world champion, Mary Kom has received the **Padma Bhushan** in **2013**, but not in 2025. 

• **Virat Kohli:** An Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian cricket team, Virat has received numerous accolades, including the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, but he did not receive the Padma Bhushan in 2025.
